title: FragmentGroup
description: In-flight MO fragment group state — returned by GET /api/fragments/inflight. Mirrors the in-memory state of fragment.Reassembler.

message_id.description: Per-IMEI fragment-group identifier (lives in the SBD fragment header)

fragments_received.description: Count of fragments arrived for this group so far

fragments_total.description: Total fragments expected (declared in the first fragment's header)

first_seen_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when the first fragment for this group arrived

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope (populated by the API layer when serving /api/fragments/inflight)
